name: Multipass Ubuntu LTS
description: Creates a four-CPU disposable Ubuntu workspace with Multipass.
create:
set -eu
# ORCA_VM_INSTANCE_ID is orca-<uuid>, already a valid Multipass instance name.
name="${ORCA_VM_INSTANCE_ID:?ORCA_VM_INSTANCE_ID is not set}"
key="${XDG_STATE_HOME:-$HOME/.local/state}/orca/multipass/id_ed25519"
if [ ! -f "$key" ]; then mkdir -p "${key%/*}" && ssh-keygen -q -t ed25519 -N '' -C orca-multipass -f "$key" >&2; fi
bundle="$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/orca-multipass.XXXXXX")"
trap 'rm -f "$bundle"; [ -n "${ok:-}" ] || multipass delete --purge "$name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT
trap 'exit 1' INT TERM
printf '#cloud-config\nssh_authorized_keys:\n  - %s\n' "$(cat "$key.pub")" | multipass launch 24.04 --name "$name" --cpus 4 --memory 8G --disk 40G --cloud-init - >&2
# A bundle of the local repo works for private repos without credentials in the VM.
git bundle create "$bundle" --branches HEAD >&2
multipass transfer "$bundle" "$name:/home/ubuntu/repo.bundle" >&2
root="/home/ubuntu/${PWD##*/}"
multipass exec "$name" -- git clone -q /home/ubuntu/repo.bundle "$root" >&2
ip="$(multipass info "$name" --format csv | awk -F, 'NR==1{for(i=1;i<=NF;i++)if(tolower($i)=="ipv4")c=i;next}c{print $c;exit}')"
[ -n "$ip" ] || { echo "Multipass reported no IPv4 address for $name" >&2; exit 1; }
esc() { printf '%s' "$1" | sed 's/[\\"]/\\&/g'; }
printf '{"schemaVersion":1,"connection":{"type":"ssh","projectRoot":"%s","target":{"label":"%s","host":"%s","port":22,"username":"ubuntu","identityFile":"%s","identitiesOnly":true}}}\n' "$(esc "$root")" "$name" "$ip" "$(esc "$key")"
ok=1
resume:
set -eu
name="${ORCA_VM_INSTANCE_ID:?ORCA_VM_INSTANCE_ID is not set}"
key="${XDG_STATE_HOME:-$HOME/.local/state}/orca/multipass/id_ed25519"
multipass start "$name" >&2
root="/home/ubuntu/${PWD##*/}"
# The VM can come back with a different address, so resume re-emits the connection.
ip="$(multipass info "$name" --format csv | awk -F, 'NR==1{for(i=1;i<=NF;i++)if(tolower($i)=="ipv4")c=i;next}c{print $c;exit}')"
[ -n "$ip" ] || { echo "Multipass reported no IPv4 address for $name" >&2; exit 1; }
esc() { printf '%s' "$1" | sed 's/[\\"]/\\&/g'; }
printf '{"schemaVersion":1,"connection":{"type":"ssh","projectRoot":"%s","target":{"label":"%s","host":"%s","port":22,"username":"ubuntu","identityFile":"%s","identitiesOnly":true}}}\n' "$(esc "$root")" "$name" "$ip" "$(esc "$key")"
destroy: { name="${ORCA_VM_INSTANCE_ID:-$(sed -n 's/.*"instanceId":"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p')}"; multipass delete --purge "${name:?No instance id in ORCA_VM_INSTANCE_ID or the stdin payload}"; }
